comment: The NuGet packages the tree reads. "sdkPackages" are packages of the Windows App SDK release named by "windowsAppSdk" in wxl.gen/profiles/base.json, at the versions that release declares; Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK.Runtime among them carries the installers of the release's Windows App Runtime, which tools/install-runtime.ps1 installs. "extra" are packages from outside the release, at their own pinned versions. tools/restore-packages.ps1 fetches every one into the NuGet package folder, and nothing else downloads anything.
